description: Make an image file smaller with little visible quality loss, on-device (same encoders and defaults as ruah.tools). Saves a new file and reports the size before and after; the original is never changed. Formats: keep = same format as the input; webp = usually the smallest and keeps transparency; avif = smaller still, slower to encode; jpeg = photos only, transparency becomes white; png = lossy palette compression that keeps transparency (or lossless=true for exact colours). Prefer webp unless the user needs a specific format. This is also the tool for converting between formats ("convert to WebP/AVIF/JPG/PNG"): set `format`. To change the pixel dimensions, use `resize` instead (it can change the format in the same step).

format.description: Output format: keep = same as the input; webp = usually smallest, keeps transparency; avif = smaller still, slower; jpeg = photos only, transparency becomes white; png = keeps transparency. Default keep.

input_path.description: Image file to compress. Absolute, ~/…, or relative to the working directory.

lossless.description: png only: keep exact colours (bigger files).

output_path.description: Where to save. Default: "<name>-compressed.<ext>" next to the input. Existing files are never overwritten.

quality.description: 1–100 for webp/avif/jpeg. Default 80 (visually near-identical, much smaller).

name: compress
title: Compress image
